messages:
Anna Chen: opened a PR to refresh the Quickstart CLI + hello-world tutorial. PR #1895. Major bits: switch to SDK v2 snippets, clarify auth flow, add a short first-deploy section, and fix the runtime-config link. preview: https://deploy-preview-1895--docs.redwood-inference.netlify.app :eyes:
Matt R.: nice! can you paste the new auth snippet here so i can skim?
Anna Chen: sure — condensed bash + powershell examples. kept it minimal so users hit the happy path quickly.
Anna Chen: ```bash
# macOS / Linux
export REDWOOD_KEY="sk_live_example"
# test a quick call
node -e "const r=require('@redwood/sdk');console.log('ok')"
```
Jia Patel: can we include a PowerShell variant for Windows folks? a single line set example is enough.
Anna Chen: good call. added this:
```powershell
$env:REDWOOD_KEY = 'sk_live_example'
node -e "require('@redwood/sdk'); Write-Host 'ok'"
```
Kevin H.: skimming PR now. quick q: you renamed REDWOOD_API_KEY -> REDWOOD_KEY in snippets — is that a doc-only change or SDK expects the new var name?
Anna Chen: SDK v2 accepts either, but we standardized on `REDWOOD_KEY` in docs to avoid confusion with older env var patterns. left a note in the changelog section.
Matt R.: small nits: in the hello-world app we should show a minimal async/await example rather than callbacks. also update the package.json example to use `type: module` to match node snippets.
Anna Chen: will update. i added an explicit `package.json` snippet and switched the code to async/await.
DocsBot: CI: deploy-preview build succeeded for PR #1895 — preview available: https://deploy-preview-1895--docs.redwood-inference.netlify.app (checks: 12 passed) :white_check_mark:
Jia Patel: wording suggestion on the auth section: replace "set your key" with "secure your key" and add one sentence about least privilege. tiny but helpful.
Anna Chen: done — updated wording + added a one-line callout about KMS for enterprise users.
Kevin H.: left 2 inline comments re: wording and a tiny grammar fix. nothing blocking. :+1:
Matt R.: i'll do a quick pass after those comments are resolved. if CI stays green and we get one more approval, i'm fine with merge. :shipit:
Anna Chen: assigning to @Kevin H. and @Matt R. for final approvals. planning to merge once green and both ok. thanks all! :raised_hands:
Kevin H.: approved.
DocsBot: PR #1895 merged by Anna Chen at 1769982999. changelog entry autogenerated. :tada:
Anna Chen: merged — follow-up task: add a short Windows troubleshooting blurb in a separate PR (opening now).
